notes.title: Actively working on the second episode of the Full Motion Video “Willage“
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=gERQdtChMs0;full][/previewyoutube]

The video shows the location of the underground passage and the approach to the hospital. At the end of the video is a small backstage. We wanted to show in the project a visual contrast between the private business development and the decaying Soviet architecture (underpass), which is gradually dying out.

We'll use a special effect to put a 3D model of a hospital cross on the skyscraper. Here the heroine of the second episode will be told some health news, and the player will have to find out the address of the protagonist of the first episode.

We liked the building nearby: the shape of the pyramid references some of the Masonic-political shenanigans of the collective farmers in the first series. It's not in the script. But it's really cool inside and out. Maybe we'll replay the whole thing and locate the hospital in it. Do you think we should change the visuals of the hospital?

[url=https://ibb.co/QfdtmfV][img]https://i.ibb.co/bPJDdPV/IMG-20220207-114021.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=https://imgbb.com/]русские гифки[/url]

Moldavian youth center building
We were also surprised by the architecture of our own city and came across the following contrasts.

[previewyoutube=BCC7ek9m2z4;full][/previewyoutube]

Video without stabilization (the rest of the clips we run through AE Warp Stabilizer) - this scene will not go into the game.

We will be distributing each subsequent episode not as DLC (with a separate cost), but as an addition to the base version of the game. That is, those who purchase the first episode will have access to all the other episodes and receive them as they're released.

This week we're doing a 30% discount. The project is short for now (for an hour), but as new episodes come out, we will significantly increase its length. The second episode will answer all the questions of the first series, but of course create new ones.
